First release of Clover Neo, a maintained fork of Clover.

- Updated for Android 16 and current libraries, requires Android 6.0 or newer
- New video player (AndroidX Media3)
- Works with edge-to-edge screens, gesture navigation and the new back gesture
- Notifications ask for permission on Android 13 and newer
- Updates are checked against the GitHub releases of Clover Neo
- Crash reporting removed, the app only talks to the sites you browse
- Fixed crashes on Android 6.0 and 16

Clover Neo installs next to the original Clover, settings and bookmarks are not carried over.
